page: The Vultr vbm-4c-32gb is a dedicated bare metal server belonging to the Bare Metal SSD family. It runs on a dedicated 4-core, 8-thread Intel Xeon E3-1270 processor built on x86_64 architecture with a base clock speed of 3.8 GHz. The CPU features 8 MB of L3 cache, 0.25 MB of L2 cache, and supports AVX, AES-NI, and BMI2 instruction sets, though it lacks newer vector extensions like AVX-512 or AMX. The instance is bundled with 32.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core) and a 480 GB local SSD. It includes no hardware GPUs and comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results place the processing capabilities of the vbm-4c-32gb in the middle range across general compute tasks, yielding a Geekbench single-core score of 1509.0, a multi-core score of 5137.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 9737.8. In PassMark memory testing, the server achieves a top-tier score of 3192.31, supported by high cached memory bandwidth of 494.72 GB/sec. However, raw uncached large-block read (31.11 GB/sec) and write (14.73 GB/sec) bandwidth tests reflect lower performance tiers, and the PassMark physics score of 717.17 falls into the lower 25th percentile.

Without GPU acceleration, the platform shows severe constraints in compute-heavy AI tasks; medium model (7B) inference registers just 16.42 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 6.87 tokens/sec for generation. Conversely, it handles lightweight and I/O-centric server workloads efficiently, processing 8.08 million Redis SET operations per second and maintaining 7.05 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

The Vultr vbm-4c-32gb serves as a dedicated single-tenant host balancing 4 dedicated CPU cores against 32 GB of RAM. It is suited for workloads requiring single-tenant isolation without hypervisor overhead, including standalone web applications, mid-sized relational databases, caching layers, and continuous integration pipelines.
description: The Vultr vbm-4c-32gb is a bare metal server powered by a dedicated 4-core, 8-thread Intel Xeon 1270 processor running at 3.8 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 32.0 GB of RAM and 480 GB of local SSD storage, it excludes GPU acceleration and operates without virtualization overhead. Benchmark metrics show reliable performance in general CPU and memory evaluation, recording a PassMark CPU score of 9737.8, a Geekbench multi-core score of 5137.0, and a high-tier PassMark memory score of 3192.31. Memory throughput shows weakness in large-block uncached read and write benchmarks, and LLM inference tasks are constrained by the absence of hardware accelerators. With steady static web throughput of 7.05 GB/sec and 8.08 million Redis SET operations per second, this server is suitable for dedicated web hosting, relational databases, and caching infrastructure.
